WEBOC Customs Registration Guide: How to Get Import/Export ID in Pakistan

An exhaustive international trade masterclass for business owners, commercial importers, and physical hardware exporters on securing a Web Based One Customs (WEBOC) User ID from Pakistan Customs, completing biometric verifications, and filing Goods Declarations (GDs).

1. What Is WEBOC (Web Based One Customs)?

Operating under the Customs Act 1969, WEBOC (Web Based One Customs) is the national digital platform developed by Pakistan Customs for clearing commercial containerized cargo, air cargo, and dry port shipments.

Whether importing tech hardware servers from China, raw manufacturing materials from Germany, or exporting physical products to Dubai, having an active WEBOC User ID is legally mandatory.

2. Statutory Prerequisites Checklist

Before applying for a WEBOC Trader User ID, your entity must obtain the following preliminary licenses:

Statutory PrerequisiteIssuing Government BodyMandatory Requirement
Active FBR NTNFederal Board of Revenue (FBR)CNIC NTN or SECP Corporate NTN registered on Iris.
FBR Sales Tax STRNFederal Board of Revenue (FBR)Active Sales Tax Registration Certificate with Sales Tax profile.
Chamber of Commerce CertificateRegional Chamber (LCCI, KCCI, ICCI)Valid membership certificate for current fiscal year.
Bank Maintenance CertificateCommercial BankBank certificate verifying active business account & IBAN.

3. Step-by-Step Customs House Submission & Biometrics

Completing physical verification at the Customs House:

Step 1: Document Folder Assembly

Assemble SECP documents, STRN certificate, Chamber certificate, bank maintenance letter, and PKR 100 stamp paper undertaking.

Step 2: Customs House Visit & Biometrics

Authorized proprietor or company director visits regional Customs House for physical verification and NADRA biometric thumbprint scan.

Step 3: Receive Credentials via Email

Within 3 to 5 business days, Pakistan Customs dispatches your official WEBOC User ID and password to your registered email.
